Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ws2 As Worksheet, ch As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ws2 = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws): ws.Activate
    ws.Range("A1:A5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c", "d"))
    ws.Range("B1:B5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3, 4))
    ws.Range("C1:C5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 5, 6, 7, 8))
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(300, 100, 300, 200).Chart
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Case 1
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(1).Hidden = True
    Case 2
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(2).Hidden = True
    Case 3
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 4
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(5).Hidden = True
    Case 5
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows("3:4").Hidden = True
    Case 6
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows("2:5").Hidden = True
    Case 7
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(9).Hidden = True
    Case 8
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True
    Case 9
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 10
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(3).Hidden = True
    Case 11
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns("B:C").Hidden = True
    Case 12
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 13
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = False
    Case 14
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).RowHeight = 0
    Case 15
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).ColumnWidth = 0
    Case 16
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Range("A1:C5").AutoFilter 2, ">2"
    Case 17
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Range("A1:C5").AutoFilter 2, ">2": ws.ShowAllData
    Case 18
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Range("A1:C5").AutoFilter 2, ">9"
    Case 19
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.PlotVisibleOnly = False: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 20
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ch.PlotVisibleOnly = False
    Case 21
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ch.PlotVisibleOnly = False: ch.PlotVisibleOnly = True
    Case 22
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.PlotVisibleOnly = False: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 23
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 24
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 25
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(3).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 26
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(3).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = False
    Case 27
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values = ws.Range("B2:B5")
    Case 28
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values = Array(7, 8, 9, 10): ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 29
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).XValues = Array("x", "y", "z", "t"): ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 30
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "z": ws.Rows(1).Hidden = True
    Case 31
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True
    Case 32
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).HasDataLabel = True
    Case 33
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ws.Rows(3).Delete
    Case 34
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ws.Rows(2).Insert
    Case 35
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ws.Range("B3").Value = 9
    Case 36
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws2.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 37
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = False
    Case 38
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True: ws.Columns(1).Hidden = False
    Case 39
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows("2:5").Hidden = True: ws.Rows("2:5").Hidden = False
    Case 40
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ch.PlotVisibleOnly = False
    Case 41
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True: ch.PlotVisibleOnly = False
    Case 42
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ws.Rows(1).Insert
    Case 43
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ws.Columns(2).Delete
    Case 44
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ws.Columns(1).Delete
    Case 45
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "z"
    Case 46
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "z": ws.Columns(2).Hidden = False
    Case 47
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    Case 48
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B5")
    Case 49
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ch.ChartType = xlLine
    Case 50
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 51
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = False
    Case 52
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = False
    Case 53
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).HasDataLabel = True: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 54
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(3).HasDataLabel = True: ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 55
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True: ws.Columns(2).Hidden = False
    Case 56
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 57
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True
    Case 58
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 59
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        ws.Rows(1).Hidden = True
    Case 60
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 61
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True
    Case 62
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 63
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ws.Rows(1).Hidden = True
    Case 64
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        ws.Rows(3).Hidden = True
    Case 65
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True
    Case 66
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 67
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlColumns
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        ws.Rows(1).Hidden = True
    Case 68
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlRows
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Case 69
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlRows
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(1).Hidden = True
    Case 70
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlRows
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Rows(2).Hidden = True
    Case 71
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlRows
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(1).Hidden = True
    Case 72
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlRows
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(2).Hidden = True
    Case 73
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C5"), xlRows
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ws.Columns(3).Hidden = True
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(2).Points.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = UBound(ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values(1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = UBound(ch.SeriesCollection(1).XValues)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = CStr(ch.SeriesCollection(1).XValues()(1))
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = CStr(ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values()(1))
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = CStr(ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values()(2))
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).DataLabel.Text
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).HasDataLabel
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.PlotVisibleOnly
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.PlotBy
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.Legend.LegendEntries.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.FullSeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection(1).IsFiltered
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
